risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and heavily quantified, but includes standard forward-looking disclaimers and a truncated discussion of strategic alternatives. Operating performance and liquidity improved in 2017, although prior-period goodwill and intangible impairments, customer loss, declining forecasts, debt financing, and reliance on judgmental valuation assumptions indicate material credit risks.
